add-multidigit.why: Column addition works because place value lets you add each column independently, and a carry is just ten of one unit traded for one of the next. Nothing about it is arbitrary once you see that.
traps: Line up by place value, not by the left edge. Adding 1,205 and 97 by lining up the first digits is the classic disaster.

sub-multidigit.why: Borrowing is the carry run backwards: you break one of the larger unit into ten of the smaller. Across a zero you have to break further left, which turns the zeros into nines.
traps: Subtracting across several zeros (1,000 - 437) is where most errors live. Either borrow carefully, or count up from 437 to 1,000 instead.

add-sub-checks.why: A professional habit worth more than speed: never report an arithmetic answer you have not checked by an independent route. Addition checks subtraction and vice versa, and digit sums catch most slips in seconds.
traps: Re-doing the same calculation the same way is not a check — you will repeat the same mistake.
